items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: Who was the clarinetist with Ted Weems for a while

ctx.x: That's true, but I haven't heard him very much, and certainly not in recent years. He's in L.A., I believe. But we seem to be talking about McCracken, and he's just one of many guys that I don't think is helpful in trying to discuss tendencies or influences in clarinet playing.
Who was the clarinetist with Ted Weems for a while, who got into Dixie working? Rosie McCard.
